equivalence_rules: Precomputing feasible radar-target-time and missile-target-time arcs is allowed if the source radar capacity, detection and missile feasibility semantics remain visible in the reference.
The objective switch between saturated and unsaturated conditions must be retained; replacing it with a fixed weighted value-cost objective is not equivalent.
Q-learning state, action, reward and adaptive local-search strategy are algorithmic mechanisms and must not be added as model variables or constraints.
algorithm_boundary: Q-learning-guided global-local evolutionary algorithm, adaptive strategy selection and knowledge-guided search are solution mechanisms, not optimization model constraints
public_private_boundary: All planted assignments, destruction schemes, sampled stochastic outcomes, objective values and algorithm traces are private validation only.
